changes.current_line: Support plans with tiered response times, up to 24/7 coverage.
changes.change: For ticketing and on-sale buyers: "A name, not a queue." A named person on every on-sale, who picks up, with a written on-sale morning plan we walk through before the sale. (Confirm who said "A name, not a queue." before using it as a customer quote.)
changes.why: The buyer rejected tiered response times as "a queue with a faster timer" and framed the question as "who," so a named person on the on-sale replaces the support-plan framing that her decision turned on.

changes.current_line: Trusted by leading businesses; see our customer stories.
changes.change: For ticketing buyers: Ask for a named reference customer who will take your call about on-sale mornings before you decide.
changes.why: The rep admits they had logos but no person to offer, and the buyer's decision depended on a named contact, so a callable reference is the proof point this buyer needs.

changes.current_line: Financial infrastructure to grow globally, in every currency.
changes.change: For ticketing and on-sale buyers: When payments fail four minutes into a sale, who answers? We name the person before the sale starts.
changes.why: The trigger was a payment failure during a public on-sale and the pain was incumbent support that answered too late, so opening on that moment speaks to the problem the buyer actually had.
